title: CNN Basics — Convolution Builds in Translation Structure
key_insight: Shared filters give convolution translation equivariance: shifting the input tends to shift the detected pattern. Pooling can make the final decision less sensitive to small shifts.
body:
## Convolution Builds in Translation Structure

Moving an object slightly should move its feature map rather than force the model to relearn the object from scratch.

Shared filters give convolution translation equivariance: shifting the input tends to shift the detected pattern. Pooling can make the final decision less sensitive to small shifts.

Depthwise separable convolution splits spatial filtering from channel mixing, cutting computation. Accelerator speed still depends on memory layout and optimized kernels, not FLOP count alone.
common_mistakes: A CNN requires a separate full model for every pixel.
Stride means the number of class labels.
Padding always deletes the image border.
